svg.title: BRHP: a branching tree from local candidates to complete-trajectory modes
svg.desc: One left-to-right tree connects two schematic objective surfaces. The first surface places expanded control-trajectory candidates and local search paths in a short-horizon objective slice. The last surface places complete root-to-leaf trajectory candidates in a full-horizon objective slice. Terminal colored curves illustrate the connection of candidate lineages to their complete-trajectory representations; they are not physical robot motion or a joint refinement of committed history. Blue and violet alternatives branch above and below the central green selected trajectory. Intermediate expansion is omitted with ellipses. Green denotes the retrospectively selected lowest-cost retained complete lineage, not the best score at every intermediate layer. Only committed prefixes compose that lineage. Surfaces and paths are conceptual, not experimental measurements, task geometry, or certificates of true basins or global optimality.
